design.title: Design system
design.intro: Every token and every base component, in both appearances and all three densities. This route exists only in development.
design.restaurantTextNote: Never translated, and marked with the language it was typed in so a screen reader pronounces it.
design.feedbackIntro: These render into a portal on the document, so they follow the document’s own density rather than a panel’s.
design.dialogTitle: Send this round to the kitchen
design.dialogBody: The dialog holds focus while it is open, closes on Escape, and hands focus back to the button that opened it.
design.alertBody: Table 4, round 2 is ready to collect.
design.sampleHint: Shown to the kitchen exactly as typed.
design.emptyBody: Tickets appear here the moment a waiter sends a round.

settings.title: Restaurant settings
settings.currencyFixed: Prices are in {{currency}}, set when you registered in {{country}}. Ask support to change it.
settings.name: Restaurant name
settings.addressHint: Printed on bills. Leave empty for none.
settings.timezoneHint: An IANA zone name, such as Asia/Kolkata. Every time on every screen is written in it.
settings.defaultLanguageHint: What the kitchen screen reads, and what staff with no language of their own see.
settings.formattingLocaleHint: How money, numbers, and dates are written. Separate from the language on purpose.
settings.failed: Those settings could not be saved.

menu.title: Menu
menu.intro: What your waiters order from, in the order your printed menu uses. Every change reaches their screens within a few seconds, so there is nothing to publish.
menu.emptyBody: Start with a category, such as Starters, then add the dishes that go in it.
menu.categoryEmpty: No dishes here yet. Add one and it reaches every waiter's screen at once.

dish.addBody: It goes at the end of its category, available, and reaches every waiter within a few seconds.
dish.name: Name
dish.nameHint: Up to 80 characters, exactly as waiters and the kitchen should read it.
dish.descriptionHint: Optional. What a waiter reads out to a guest, up to 300 characters.
dish.priceHint_one: In {{currency}}, with up to {{count}} decimal place.
dish.priceHint_other: In {{currency}}, with up to {{count}} decimal places.
dish.editBody: Changes reach every waiter within a few seconds. Dishes already sent to the kitchen keep the name and price they were ordered at.
dish.moveHint: Choosing another category moves the dish to the end of it.

category.addBody: It goes at the end of the menu. Waiters see it once it has a dish in it.
category.renameBody: The new name reaches every waiter within a few seconds.
category.name: Name
category.nameHint: Up to 60 characters, such as Starters or Breads.

order.dishInstructions: To move a dish, press Space or Enter to pick it up. Use the up and down arrow keys to move it within its category, then press Space or Enter again to drop it, or Escape to put it back.
order.categoryInstructions: To move a category, press Space or Enter to pick it up. Use the up and down arrow keys to move it, then press Space or Enter again to drop it, or Escape to put it back.
order.pickedUp: Picked up {{name}}. It is in position {{position}} of {{total}}.
order.droppedBack: {{name}} was put back where it was.
order.cancelled: Moving cancelled. {{name}} is back in position {{position}} of {{total}}.

remove.dishBody: It comes off every waiter's screen at once. Anything already ordered stays on its bill exactly as it was, and you can put the dish back from Archived.
remove.categoryBody: It comes off the menu, and you can put it back from Archived.
remove.categoryNotEmpty_one: It still has {{count}} dish in it. Move or remove that dish first, or this will be refused.
remove.categoryNotEmpty_other: It still has {{count}} dishes in it. Move or remove them first, or this will be refused.

archived.title: Archived
archived.intro: Removed dishes and categories. They are off every screen, every bill that charged for them still reads as it did, and each can be put back.
archived.empty: Nothing removed. Anything you remove lands here and can be put back.
archived.restoreDishBody: It goes at the end of the category you choose, with its price, its diet marker, and its availability as they were.
archived.oldCategoryGone: Its old category, {{category}}, is removed too, so choose another.
archived.noLiveCategory: There is no category on the menu to put it in. Add a category first.

staff.title: Staff
staff.intro: Everybody who works here. You create the accounts and hand out the passwords; nobody signs themselves up, and a password you hand over is good for exactly one sign in.
staff.owingCount_one: {{count}} has not chosen a password yet
staff.owingCount_other: {{count}} have not chosen a password yet
staff.activeCaption: Everybody currently working here, with their role and when they last signed in.
staff.inactiveBody: These accounts cannot sign in. Their name stays on every order and bill they handled, which is why they are switched off rather than removed.
staff.inactiveCaption: Accounts that have been switched off, and can be brought back.
staff.emptyBody: Add the waiters and chefs who work with you. You choose their first password and hand it over in person.
staff.name: Name
staff.nameHint: Up to 80 characters, as it should read on a ticket.
staff.emailHint: What they sign in with. It cannot be changed afterwards, so check it now.
staff.roleHint: What they may do. It decides which screen they land on.
staff.owesPassword: Has not chosen a password yet

create.title: Add somebody
create.body: They can sign in straight away, and the first thing they will be asked is to choose their own password.
create.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. You read this out once and they replace it at their first sign in.
create.doneBody: Hand these over. This is the only time the password is shown.
create.onceOnly: They must choose their own password the first time they sign in, and this one stops working then. If you lose it before handing it over, reset it and a new one is shown.

edit.name: Rename
edit.nameBody: Only what they are called on screen. They stay signed in wherever they are.
edit.roleBody: This signs them out of every device at once, so their next tap runs under the new role.
edit.roleHint: Changing this signs them out everywhere.
edit.roleChanged: {{name}} is now a {{role}}, and has been signed out everywhere.
edit.roleUnchanged: {{name}} is already a {{role}}. Nothing changed, and they are still signed in.

reset.title: Reset {{name}}'s password
reset.body: This signs them out of every device and they must choose their own password at their next sign in.
reset.doneBody: Hand these over. This is the only time the password is shown.
reset.done: {{name}}'s password was reset, and they have been signed out everywhere.

deactivate.title: Switch {{name}}'s account off?
deactivate.body: They are signed out everywhere at once and cannot sign in again. Anything they have open on the floor stays exactly where it is, and their name stays on it. You can bring the account back later.
deactivate.done: {{name}} was switched off and signed out everywhere.

floor.title: Tables
floor.intro: Your rooms and tables, in the order your staff walk them. Every change reaches the waiters' screens within a few seconds, so there is nothing to publish.
floor.addTableUnsectioned: Add a table with no section
floor.emptyBody: Add your first table. You can group tables into sections, such as Terrace, whenever you like.
floor.sectionEmpty: No tables here yet. Add one and it reaches every waiter's floor at once.

section.addBody: A room or area, such as Terrace. It goes at the end of the list, and waiters see it once it has a table in it.
section.renameBody: The new name reaches every waiter within a few seconds.
section.name: Name
section.nameHint: Up to 40 characters, such as Terrace or Bar.

table.addBody: New tables go at the end of their section and reach every waiter within a few seconds.
table.label: Label
table.labelHint: Up to 12 characters, such as 12 or Bar 3. No two tables may share one.
table.seatsHint: Optional. A whole number from 1 to 50.
table.moveHint: Choosing another section moves the table to the end of it.
table.prefixHint: Optional, such as T, or Bar with a space after it.
table.rangeHint: Whole numbers from 1 to 999, and at most 50 tables at a time.
table.clashes: Nothing was added. These labels are already used by other tables: {{labels}}.
table.clashGone: A label was taken a moment ago and nothing was added. Try again.
table.editBody: Changes reach the waiters and the kitchen within a few seconds, even while a party is seated.

order.tableInstructions: To move a table, press Space or Enter to pick it up. Use the up and down arrow keys to move it within its section, then press Space or Enter again to drop it, or Escape to put it back.
order.sectionInstructions: To move a section, press Space or Enter to pick it up. Use the up and down arrow keys to move it, then press Space or Enter again to drop it, or Escape to put it back.
order.pickedUp: Picked up {{name}}. It is in position {{position}} of {{total}}.
order.droppedBack: {{name}} was put back where it was.
order.cancelled: Moving cancelled. {{name}} is back in position {{position}} of {{total}}.

remove.tableBody: It comes off every waiter's floor at once. Past bills still show its label, and you can put it back from Archived.
remove.tableBusy: A party is at this table now. Close the table first, or this will be refused.
remove.tableDone: Table {{table}} removed. It is in Archived.
remove.sectionBody: It comes off the floor, and you can put it back from Archived.
remove.sectionNotEmpty_one: It still has {{count}} table in it. Move or remove that table first, or this will be refused.
remove.sectionNotEmpty_other: It still has {{count}} tables in it. Move or remove them first, or this will be refused.

archived.title: Archived
archived.intro: Removed sections and tables. They are off every waiter's floor, past bills still show them, and each can be put back.
archived.empty: Nothing removed. Anything you remove lands here and can be put back.
archived.withTables_one: {{count}} removed table can come back with it
archived.withTables_other: {{count}} removed tables can come back with it
archived.restoreTableBody: It goes at the end of the section you choose, with its label and seats as they were.
archived.oldSectionGone: Its old section, {{section}}, is removed too, so it starts on No section.
archived.tableRestored: Table {{table}} is back on the floor
archived.restoreSectionBody: It goes at the end of the section list. The ticked tables come back into it, in their old order.
archived.restoreSectionNone: No removed tables were in this section.
archived.restoreClashes: Nothing was put back. These labels are already used by other tables: {{labels}}. Untick them, or rename the other tables first.
